title: Partners
text: From research organizations, weather forecasting centres, EO data specialists and cloud platform experts to GEO and DestinE contributors.
map_alt: Map of Europe highlighting the partner countries: Norway, Denmark, the United Kingdom, France, Italy, Austria and Greece.

partners.name: LINKS Foundation
partners.description: Advances the use of MSG/MTG-derived vegetation information to assess effectiveness and supports integration of the application workflows within the shared platform.

partners.name: Ithaca S.r.l.
partners.description: Provides advanced capabilities in satellite data processing, 3D modeling, and experience with Copernicus Emergency Mapping Services flood products.

partners.name: Neuropublic
partners.description: Leads APP2 development, coordinates co-design with farmers, and utilizes its extensive in-field sensor network.

partners.name: European Centre for Medium-Range Weather Forecasts
partners.description: Contributes forecast and notification capabilities that underpin reliable, geofenced triggering and alert delivery.

partners.name: SISTEMA
partners.description: Enables deployment and integration of APP2 components within the common data space and supports validation of triggering factors and outcomes.

partners.name: Danish Meteorological Institute
partners.description: Contributes expertise in weather forecasting, postprocessing, and hydrological modeling to support real-time flood alert generation.

partners.name: SUEZ Group
partners.logo_alt: ARIA Technologies, a SUEZ company, logo
partners.description: CLEAR-EO partner involved in the Air quality in urban areas application.

partners.name: Université Paris-Est Créteil
partners.description: CLEAR-EO partner involved in the Air quality in urban areas application.

partners.name: BLB
partners.description: Leads dissemination and engagement activities, helping connect Earth observation data, scientific innovation, and user communities to support the development of actionable Earth intelligence.

affiliated.name: Politecnico di Torino
affiliated.description: Specializes in high-resolution 3D LiDAR data processing, particularly in complex urban environments, enabling accurate flood impact simulations.

women.text: On International Women’s Day, CLEAR-EO celebrates the many women contributing their expertise to the project. Around 50% of the consortium’s experts are women, working across Earth observation, data science, climate services, and environmental intelligence.
women.link_label: International Women’s Day: Highlighting the Women of CLEAR-EO

collaborations.name: Farmtopia
collaborations.text: Farmtopia collaborates with CLEAR-EO on agricultural applications, connecting Earth observation data with real-world farming needs.
